verifications.claim: Eid prayer occurs after sunrise but before the Dhuhr prayer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'anytime after sunrise and before noon'; R5: 'any time after sunrise and before the Zuhr prayer'; R7: 'after the sun has risen... before zawaal' (zenith ~noon)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the timing as after sunrise and before noon/zenith/Zuhr (Dhuhr).

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'bathing or Ghusl prior to attending the festival'; R7: 'it’s sunnah to take a shower (i.e. perform ghusl) before you settle down to pray'
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm ghusl/bathing before Eid prayer as per Sunnah.

verifications.claim: It is Sunnah to eat an odd number of dates before the Eid prayer.
